standard-dialogue.npc: Greetings, young one, how may I be of assistance?

steps.npc: My name is Amergin and this here is my canoe station.

steps.player: What does a wizard want with a canoe station?

steps.npc: I am not a mere wizard, I am a druid. I once belonged to the tower next to me, but not anymore. They are a bit of a crazy bunch, so instead I keep them at bay and look after this canoe station as well.
Want to know more about canoes?
No problem, come back anytime.

options.text: Can you teach me about canoes?

steps.player: Could you teach me about canoes?

steps.npc: No I can't, I sense you lack the experience to make any canoe. You will need to keep training with the axe.
Once you do, you will be able to make a canoe to travel the river.
Of course I can, use your axe to chop down this tree here. You may then use your axe to shape the log into a canoe.

By the looks of it, you do not contain the required knowledge to build more than a log. This won't get you very far. Practice some more with the axe and you'll be able to make sturdier canoes one day.
Of course I can, use your axe to chop down this tree here. You may then use your axe to shape the log into a canoe.
Hmm, it seems you should be able to make a reasonably durable canoe with your knowledge. A dugout, to be precise.

steps.player: How far will I be able to go in a dugout canoe?

steps.npc: Around two stops before it will meet its end.
Of course I can, use your axe to chop down this tree here. You may then use your axe to shape the log into a canoe.
Hmm good, I sense you are one that should be able to make a decent canoe.

steps.player: Really, how far will I be able to go?

steps.npc: Very far, although it will not reach the whole way down the river.
Of course I can, use your axe to chop down this tree here. You may then use your axe to shape the log into a canoe.
I see it, you have the makings of a woodsman? You will be able to craft nothing but the best canoes that will get you anywhere along the river!

options.text: Can you hold onto my axe?

steps.text: If they're not already holding onto an axe:

steps.player: Can you hold onto my axe?

steps.npc: I sure can, you can even use the axe to make a canoe while I hold onto it for you.

steps.text: If they're already holding onto an axe:

steps.npc: I already have you're axe, would you like it back?

steps.player: Yes, I would like my axe back.

steps.npc: Here's your axe.

steps.player: No, hold onto it for me.

steps.text: If you don't have a valid axe to give:

steps.npc: I could, but you don't have an axe that you have the Woodcutting level to use.

store-axe.text: If they're not already holding onto an axe:

steps.npc: I'll hold onto that axe for you.

store-axe.text: If they're already holding onto an axe:

steps.npc: Here's your axe.
